description: This file defines basic arithmetic operations, macros, and inline functions for fixed-point math, including saturation, normalization, shifting, addition, subtraction, multiplication, and their 32-bit and 16-bit variants, used in audio codec implementations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Performs saturated addition of two 16-bit words with overflow control.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Performs saturated subtraction of two 16-bit words with overflow control.

methods.name: shl
methods.description: Arithmetically shifts a 16-bit word left or right with saturation.

methods.name: shr
methods.description: Arithmetically shifts a 16-bit word right or left with sign extension and saturation.

methods.name: mult
methods.description: Multiplies two 16-bit words, scales result to 16 bits with saturation.

methods.name: L_mult
methods.description: Multiplies two 16-bit words, returns a 32-bit scaled result.

methods.name: voround
methods.description: Rounds a 32-bit number to 16 bits with saturation.

methods.name: L_mac
methods.description: Multiply-accumulate: multiplies two 16-bit words, shifts, and adds to a 32-bit accumulator.

methods.name: L_msu
methods.description: Multiply-subtract: multiplies two 16-bit words, shifts, and subtracts from a 32-bit accumulator.

methods.name: L_add
methods.description: Adds two 32-bit words with overflow control and saturation.

methods.name: L_sub
methods.description: Subtracts two 32-bit words with overflow control and saturation.

methods.name: mult_r
methods.description: Multiplies two 16-bit words with rounding and saturation.

methods.name: L_shl
methods.description: Arithmetically shifts a 32-bit number left or right with saturation.

methods.name: L_shl2
methods.description: Alternative implementation for shifting 32-bit number left with saturation.

methods.name: L_shr
methods.description: Arithmetically shifts a 32-bit number right or left with sign extension and saturation.

methods.name: L_shr_r
methods.description: Shifts a 32-bit number right with rounding and saturation.

methods.name: norm_s
methods.description: Calculates the number of left shifts to normalize a 16-bit number.

methods.name: div_s
methods.description: Performs fractional division of two positive 16-bit numbers.

methods.name: norm_l
methods.description: Calculates the number of left shifts to normalize a 32-bit number.
